method: Hand-labelled by reading each exhibit. Every value carries the sentence it was read from, so a label can be checked against the filed document.
absent_means: The exhibit does not state the term. It does not mean the label could not be found.
note: edgar-01 and edgar-03 are the SAME lease filed twice: Inuvo is the renamed FindWhat.com and both filings attach the identical Colonial Bank Plaza lease. Scoring both would double-weight one lease's quirks, so edgar-03 is marked a duplicate and excluded from scoring.
